cards.back: Put groups together to find how many in all.
Take away or find how many are left.
A box with 10 spaces in 2 rows of 5.
Find two numbers that add to 10.
One of the groups that make a whole.

cards.front: Which number goes with 7 to make 10?

cards.back: 6. Adding 0 does not change a number.
